applicationMode.REFERENCE_ONLY: Reference only: kept as accepted input, applied to no record
applicationMode.UPDATE_ALLOWED_SOURCE_FIELDS: Applied to its source record after acceptance

applicationExplain.PENDING: Accepted by AHDA and not yet applied to its source record.
applicationExplain.CONFLICT: The source record changed after the answer was given. Nothing was applied. Revalidate to confirm the answer still applies, then apply it again.
applicationExplain.REVALIDATED: A conflict was confirmed against the record as it is now. Apply it again.
applicationExplain.RETRYABLE: The source record refused the change for now, for example because its project or task is not in a state that takes it. Nothing was applied. Apply it again once it can.
applicationExplain.FAILED: The source record is gone or closed, so the answer can never be applied. The request is closed.
applicationExplain.PENDING_AT: Accepted on {date}; not yet applied to its source record.
applicationExplain.CONFLICT_VERSIONS: Conflict: the source record changed after the answer was given (answered against version {expected}, now version {found}). Nothing was applied. Revalidate to confirm the answer still applies, then apply it again.
applicationExplain.REVALIDATED_BY: Conflict revalidated by {person} against version {version}. Apply it again.
applicationExplain.RETRYABLE_BECAUSE: Not applied: {failure} Nothing was changed. Apply it again once the record can take it.
applicationExplain.FAILED_BECAUSE: Failed: {failure} Nothing was applied, and the request is closed.

failure.SOURCE_RECORD_NOT_FOUND: the source record no longer exists.
failure.SOURCE_RECORD_TERMINAL: the source record is closed (for example, the task was cancelled).
failure.SOURCE_RECORD_STATE_INVALID: the task does not take a percentage in its current state (only an in-progress or blocked task without subtasks does).

apply.title: Apply to the source record
apply.retryTitle: Apply to the source record again
apply.consequence: The accepted answer is applied through the source's own rules. If the record changed since the answer was given, nothing is applied and a conflict is recorded; if the record cannot take it now, nothing is applied and the refusal is recorded.

issue.title: Issue the request
issue.consequence: The entity's responder can see and answer it from now on. The responder, the reviewer and a due date not before today are required.

delete.title: Delete the draft
delete.consequence: The draft is deleted. The entity never saw it.

cancel.title: Cancel the request
cancel.consequence: The entity can no longer answer it. A response already with its reviewer is decided instead.

submit.title: Submit your response
submit.consequence: Your response goes to AHDA for review. Once submitted it cannot be changed; AHDA may return it to you for correction.

startReview.title: Start the review
startReview.consequence: You take this response into review; then accept, return or reject it.

accept.title: Accept the response
accept.consequence: The response is accepted as submitted. An answer for a source record waits to be applied to it; a reference-only answer is complete.

return.title: Return for correction
return.consequence: The entity gets a new revision holding the same values to correct and submit again. This revision stays as submitted.

reject.title: Reject the response
reject.consequence: The response is rejected and the request is closed. Nothing is applied.

revalidate.title: Revalidate the conflict
revalidate.consequence: Confirm that the accepted answer still applies to the source record as it is now (version {found}). The next attempt expects that version.

done.saved: Draft saved. The entity cannot see it until it is issued.
done.issued: Request issued. The entity's responder can answer it now.
done.submitted: Response submitted to AHDA for review.
done.returned: Response returned for correction. The entity has a new revision to correct.
done.rejected: Response rejected. The request is closed.
done.conflictRecorded: Not applied: the source record changed since the answer was given. The conflict is recorded; revalidate it, then apply again.
done.failureRecorded: Not applied: the source record refused the change. The refusal is recorded with the answer.
